svg.title: Vyom planned deployment architecture
svg.desc: Kind from S1, EKS from S2. Inside the cluster are frontend, a single FastAPI and LangGraph backend, Keycloak from S6, RAG retrieval inside the backend, jobs and Postgres/Qdrant from S3, a pinned upstream Kubernetes MCP server, and the full observability namespace from S1. External dependencies include a configured compatible model endpoint, Bedrock from S3, AWS-managed MCP and AWS APIs from S2, and protected backup storage from S5. Five main connections show HTTP, private MCP, scoped Kubernetes reads, storage clients and external provider calls.
svg.text: Personal alpha · sprint labels show introduction · no deployed capability claimed
Metrics, sanitized logs and owned traces · bounded export · private Grafana
Internal Services · localhost port-forward before S6 · credentials stay server-side
Boxes show deployment components. Backend modules share one process; collection and query paths are documented separately.
